note: Mossy's escort - the only thing in the game that moves without the player or the horde owning it. Driven over whole drone lifetimes, because the orbit's arrival gate, the build clock and the magazine are all only wrong over time. The acquisition circle is drawn around the PLAYER and a case holds that shut: a drone-anchored circle is transitive and walks the drone off the screen one legal hop at a time, which is exactly what it did.
